# IngrediPeek

> Food Allergen & Ingredient Checker

Check food allergens, ingredients, and dietary compatibility for thousands of products. Find gluten-free, vegan, halal, and nut-free foods instantly.

## Core pages
- [Methodology and data sources](https://ingredipeek.com/methodology/): how every figure is derived, with primary-source citations
- [Compare](https://ingredipeek.com/compare/): side-by-side comparison
- [About and editorial standards](https://ingredipeek.com/about/): authorship and review policy

## Data
- Primary sources: FDA Food Additive Status List, FDA GRAS Notice Inventory, EFSA Food Additives Database, USDA FoodData Central
- All figures are derived from these primary sources; see /methodology/ for derivation and vintage.
